description: This file extends Leaflet's DomEvent to add support for pointer and touch events, including handling for IE and Windows devices. It manages pointer event listeners, tracks active pointers, and provides functions to add and remove pointer event handlers.

methods.name: addPointerListener
methods.description: Adds a pointer event listener for touchstart, touchmove, or touchend events.

methods.name: removePointerListener
methods.description: Removes a pointer event listener based on event type and handler id.
